# DISCOLAND
> DISCOLAND is a Turkey-based live disco performance project founded by vocalist Buse Türker and DJ/sound producer Erdi İltaş. The act delivers 90-minute non-stop live vocal + DJ sets that revive classic disco culture with a modern stage aesthetic.

## Artists
- Buse Türker: Founder & Vocalist
- Erdi İltaş: DJ & Sound Producer

## Concept & Performance
- Live vocal + DJ performance
- 90-minute non-stop set with custom arrangements and costumes
- Booking: booking@wearediscoland.com
